description: Cycle Parking in the Urban Core is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Newcastle City Council. Locations of cycle parking in the Urban Core with details on the number of spaces, type of stand, the main land use attractor, if it is covered and its condition. This data covers publicly available cycle parking in Newcastle-upon-Tyne's Urban Core. Coverage: Newcastle City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Newcastle City Council. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, KML. The portal shows 2016-03-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
